TMLD.description: Construction Stage Loads (TMLD). Defines time (day) loads applied during construction stages; the top-level key is the construction-stage/target entity key and ITEMS holds one entry per associated load group.

ITEMS.description: List of time-load entries for this entity. Each entry ties a load group to the day at which the load is activated during the construction stage.

ID.description: Serial number of the item within the entity key (union-key serial). Used to match/replace an existing entry; when omitted or 0 a new serial is assigned.

GROUP_NAME.description: Name of an existing load group. Empty string means no load group. If non-empty, the name must resolve to an existing load group or the request is rejected.

DAY.description: Day (time) at which the load is applied during the construction stage.
